calls.statement:
WITH p AS (SELECT DATE '2025-12-21' AS e),
base AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, m.member_id, s.store_id, pr.category, f.channel_code, f.receipt_id, f.staff_purchase_flag, w.status
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product pr ON pr.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id AND s.store_id=900
  CROSS JOIN p
  WHERE f.sale_date > p.e-364 AND f.sale_date <= p.e
),
v_all AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM base),
v_excl AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM base WHERE store_id<>999 AND category<>'ZZ Test'),
v_excl_canc AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM base WHERE store_id<>999 AND category<>'ZZ Test' AND coalesce(status,'x')<>'cancelled'),
tiers AS (SELECT member_id, tier, count(*) over (partition by member_id) n FROM dim_member, p WHERE p.e BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to)
SELECT 'all' v, t.tier, count(*) c, count(distinct a.member_id) d FROM v_all a LEFT JOIN tiers t USING(member_id) GROUP BY ALL
UNION ALL SELECT 'excl', t.tier, count(*), count(distinct a.member_id) FROM v_excl a LEFT JOIN tiers t USING(member_id) GROUP BY ALL
UNION ALL SELECT 'excl_canc', t.tier, count(*), count(distinct a.member_id) FROM v_excl_canc a LEFT JOIN tiers t USING(member_id) GROUP BY ALL
UNION ALL SELECT 'maxn', null, max(n), 0 FROM tiers
ORDER BY 1,2

calls.statement:
WITH w AS (
 SELECT f.*, m.member_id AS mid, m.join_date
 FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key
 WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2025-12-21'-364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2025-12-21')
SELECT count(*) lines, count(member_key) with_key, count(mid) matched, count(*) filter (where member_key is not null and mid is null) orphans,
 count(*) filter (where join_date > sale_date) before_join, min(sale_date) mn, max(sale_date) mx, count(distinct sale_date) days,
 count(distinct sales_line_id) dl, count(*) filter (where sale_date > DATE '2025-12-21') x,
 count(distinct mid) members, count(distinct member_key) keys,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE valid_from > valid_to) badv,
 (SELECT count(*) - count(distinct member_key) FROM dim_member) dupkeys
FROM w

WITH w AS (
 SELECT f.*, m.member_id AS mid, m.join_date AS jd
 FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key

SELECT count(*) AS n_lines, count(member_key) AS with_key, count(mid) AS n_matched, count(*) filter (where member_key is not null and mid is null) AS orphans,
 count(*) filter (where jd > sale_date) AS before_join, min(sale_date) AS mn, max(sale_date) AS mx, count(distinct sale_date) AS n_days,
 count(distinct sales_line_id) AS n_distinct_lines,
 count(distinct mid) AS members, count(distinct member_key) AS n_keys,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE valid_from > valid_to) AS badv,
 (SELECT count(*) - count(distinct member_key) FROM dim_member) AS dupkeys
FROM w
